skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Use inference.sh apps to post, retrieve, like, retweet, delete, DM, follow, and inspect Twitter/X content from an authorized account.
skill.summary: Run authorized Twitter/X posting and engagement workflows through inference.sh.
skill.author: tul-sh

security_audit.summary: The static backtick findings are partly Markdown false positives, but several documented infsh and npx commands are real external actions that can publish, modify, or retrieve Twitter/X account data. The highest concern is semantic: the skill enables automated public engagement, direct messages, follows, and deletion workflows that require strong user confirmation and anti-abuse controls.

remediation.issue: Live Twitter/X actions can publish, delete, message, follow, like, or retweet from an authenticated account.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation of the account, action, target ID, message text, post text, and media URL before each live command.

remediation.issue: Engagement and direct message workflows can be misused for spam or artificial engagement.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear anti-abuse guidance covering consent, rate limits, platform rules, and prohibited mass automation.

remediation.issue: npx installation examples can install additional external skill packages.
remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted package references where possible and instruct users to review package source before running install commands.

remediation.issue: The Markdown embeds a remote image from cloud.inference.sh.
remediation.suggestion: Use a bundled marketplace image or document that rendering the README may load external content.

semantic_findings.description: The skill advertises engagement automation and documents likes, retweets, DMs, and follows. These actions can enable spam, unsolicited messaging, artificial engagement, or account abuse if used without consent and limits.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly lists social engagement and messaging capabilities, including DMs and follows. The risk is contextual rather than a code pattern, so static scanning would not fully capture it.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The delete capability and command example are explicit. The missing confirmation guidance is based on review of the single scanned file.

content.value_statement: Managing Twitter/X actions through an AI assistant can be slow and error-prone. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured prompts for authorized posting, engagement, and account lookups through inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Posts text updates to Twitter/X through the inference.sh x/post-tweet app.
Creates media posts when the user supplies a media URL or generated asset URL.
Likes, retweets, follows users, and sends direct messages from an authorized account.
Retrieves user profiles and tweet details by username or tweet ID.
Deletes posts through the x/post-delete app when given a tweet ID.
Combines inference.sh media generation apps with Twitter/X posting workflows.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated Twitter/X integration.
Does not bypass X platform limits, consent rules, or account safety checks.
Runs live account actions, so incorrect IDs or text can affect a real account.
Does not provide built-in scheduling, analytics, moderation, or approval queues.

use_cases.title: Publish Account Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare and publish a short text update from an authorized brand or project account.

use_cases.title: Share Generated Media
use_cases.description: Generate an image or video with inference.sh, then publish it with reviewed caption text.

use_cases.title: Inspect and Respond
use_cases.description: Look up a user or post, then decide whether to like, retweet, follow, or send a direct message.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Text Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a single reviewed post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use twitter-automation to post this exact text to my authorized X account: [text]. Confirm the account and text before running any command.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for a post with a supplied media URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Twitter/X post with this caption and media URL: [caption] [media URL]. Show me the final caption and media URL before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Post Before Engagement
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for safe engagement with an existing post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Get details for tweet ID [tweet ID]. Summarize the visible information, then ask before liking or retweeting it.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Reviewed Launch Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow that combines content creation and social posting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a launch image using inference.sh, draft a short X caption, and prepare a media post. Require my approval before any public action.

output_examples.input: Post a short product update after I approve it.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the account, displays the exact post text, waits for approval, then publishes the update through inference.sh.

output_examples.input: Look up a tweet and decide whether to retweet it.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves the tweet details, summarizes the visible content, and asks for confirmation before taking any engagement action.

output_examples.input: Share an approved image with a caption.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares a media post using the supplied image URL and caption, then waits for final approval before publishing.

best_practices: Confirm the authenticated account, exact text, target ID, and media URL before every live action.
Use the skill only for accounts and recipients where you have clear authorization.
Respect X platform rules, rate limits, consent expectations, and brand review processes.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for unsolicited mass DMs, spam follows, or artificial engagement.
Do not publish generated media without checking rights, accuracy, and disclosure needs.
Do not run delete, follow, like, retweet, or DM actions from unverified IDs.

faq.question: Does this skill post directly to Twitter/X?
faq.answer: Yes. It can run inference.sh apps that perform live actions on an authenticated Twitter/X account.

faq.question: Does it require credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. The inference.sh CLI must be installed and connected to a Twitter/X integration before live actions work.

faq.question: Can it send direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a direct message workflow, but users should confirm recipient IDs and consent first.

faq.question: Can it schedule posts?
faq.answer: The reviewed file does not show a dedicated scheduling command. It focuses on immediate actions through inference.sh apps.

faq.question: Can it generate media?
faq.answer: It shows workflows that call inference.sh image or video apps, then publish the resulting media URL to Twitter/X.

faq.question: What should I review before running it?
faq.answer: Review the account, text, media URL, tweet ID, recipient ID, and target username before any command runs.
